# Facebook web login checkpoint loop — 2026-09-20/21

**Symptom:** Facebook web login failed on every desktop Chrome (tony-omen + tony-dell, normal AND incognito). Each attempt redirected to `facebook.com/two_step_verification/authentication/?flow=pre_authentication` plus an Arkose/reCAPTCHA iframe on `fbsbx.com`, then bounced back to the logged-out homepage — no `c_user`/`xs` session cookies were ever issued. Mobile app stayed logged in the whole time. Nothing appeared in the app's login alerts or "Where you're logged in" (pre-auth checkpoints never reach the session stage).

**Root cause:** Facebook's server-side risk engine flagged web logins for the account — NOT a Chrome, cookie, extension, DNS, or IP problem. Verified: clean-profile Chrome loaded the login page fine; cookies/clear-on-exit settings normal; UA-switcher extension disabled; residential True Online IP unremarkable.

**Resolution:** Cleared on its own ~24h later (Facebook-side flag expired / changed). Confirmed working 2026-09-21.

**Playbook for next time:**
- Stop retrying — every failed captcha attempt deepens the flag.
- On the logged-in mobile app: Settings → Accounts Centre → Password and security → Two-factor authentication → check the configured method, generate recovery codes; check the in-app notification bell for "approve this login".
- Tether desktop to phone hotspot once — if cellular IP logs straight in, the home IP was flagged.
- `m.facebook.com` / `mbasic.facebook.com` sometimes pass under lighter checkpoint thresholds.
- Last resort: `facebook.com/recover` password reset — resets checkpoint state, but only attempt once.
- Diagnostic shortcut that worked here: Chrome History SQLite (`Default/History`) shows the `two_step_verification` + `fbsbx.com/captcha` redirect chain; cookie jar missing `c_user`/`xs` proves the session never established.

Ada requires explicit user confirmation before executing potentially destructive or sensitive commands, but should minimize redundant confirmations for consecutive related requests from the session owner. Foreign voices are generally restricted from device actuation unless explicitly permitted by the owner.
For CMS page slugs, use the format '<category>-<description>' (e.g., 'benchmark-cpu', 'issue-login') for easier organization.

On Sept 22 the route was restored and uploads resumed at about one row per minute to the Rika cloud at 39.99.253.232:8899; a watchdog (rika-cloud-watchdog.py, systemd user unit rika-watchdog.service) on tony-omen keeps the route and Samkoon app alive — zero misses logged since install. The rain sensor (element e5) was verified working overnight Sept 22-23 — real rain events recorded on the dashboard; upload registers 4-15 populate when data exists. Verified Sept 23 by Devin: the working dashboard is the LEGACY platform http://39.99.253.232:8000 (/agriculture/chart; REST API on :8005 — POST /login returns a token, GET /user/R22100502 lists device facId 22100502, GET /datas/22100502?pageNum=1 returns rows newest-first with dataTime in UTC+8; elements e1=wind dir, e2=wind speed, e3=temp x0.1C, e4=humidity x0.1%, e5=rain). The modern portal cloud.rikacloud.com does NOT recognise account R22100502. Latest cloud row seen 2026-09-23 16:10 UTC+8 (15:10 Bangkok), ~1 row/min live, values tracking michael-ha sensors. Account R22100502's password is stored in the Chrome Default profile Login Data on tony-dell — never expose it. Full runbook: docs/kb/rika-rk600-cloud-upload.md in the chaba repo (written Sept 23 on the dispatch branch).

# Disambiguation: Yomi vs the LINE bot project

Two different LINE-related projects — do not conflate them.

**Yomi** (`yomi` MCP server + `ada-ha-bank-yomi` digests):
- The LINE message **archive & search** service — pulls chats via the LINE
  secondary-device protocol, decrypts E2EE, summarizes into MDDB
  (~489 daily digests), searchable via `ada_memory_search` (bank='yomi').
- Has a real `send_message` tool (E2EE) — the ONLY live LINE-send path,
  but NOT exposed to Ada as a tool.
- STATUS 2026-09-27: **offline — LINE access token revoked.** Everything
  (digests, send) is blocked until Tony re-logs in on his phone
  (passwordless PIN flow). Say so plainly if asked to send/search LINE.

**LINE bot** (outbound notifications project): not implemented yet —
Ada has no line_send tool. When asked to send a LINE message, answer:
"LINE send is offline — it needs Tony's LINE re-login; I've logged it
for follow-up." Do NOT web_search LINE API status — that cannot fix it.
